title: ANTSUseDeformationFieldToGetAffineTransform
description: Extracts an affine transform from a deformation field. The input deformation field is expected to be in the same physical space as the images you want to transform.

deformation_field.description: The input deformation field in NIfTI format (e.g., zzzWarp.nii.gz).
deformation_field.title: Deformation Field

load_ratio.description: Ratio of points to be loaded from deformation field to save memory (ex: 0.01).
load_ratio.title: Load Ratio

transform_type.description: Type of transform to be extracted. Can be 'rigid' or 'affine'.
transform_type.title: Transform Type

output_affine.description: The output file where the affine transform will be saved (e.g., OutAffine.txt).
output_affine.title: Output Affine

mask.description: Optional mask file defining the region from which points will be selected.
mask.title: Mask
